title: Equity, consolidation and ownership
review_type: Author mathematical, financial, instructional and source-scope review; coordinator acceptance pending

scope.teach_back: Prompt, concrete numerical example and criteria supplied
scope.artifacts: Static fragment; exact synthetic input; standard-library journal/consolidation program; preserved output; README; independently formulated checker; six actual-inspection source proposals

financial_review: Ordinary residual equity is stipulated; liabilities versus equity depend on contractual terms rather than instrument names. Par/market prices, capital/APIC/retained earnings and cash are separated.

Share issuance, dividends, treasury cost, reissue above/below cost and closing are debit-credit reconciled. Issued, treasury and outstanding counts differ; observer never trades; unsupported buybacks/reissues or negative cash fail.

Dilution wealth change n(Np-V)/(N+n) derived from unchanged old-business value and issue cash. Fair-price issue/buyback examples separate ownership fractions, book equity and economic value. Simple prospective per-share earnings comparison is not presented as reported EPS.

Control is stipulated independently of ownership. Business status, matched dates/policies, identifiable fair values, proportionate NCI and separate-parent cost/dividend-income method are explicit. No simple majority rule or universal full-consolidation claim.

Acquisition worksheet balances: eliminate subsidiary capital100/pre-acquisition RE60, add goodwill30, remove investment150, recognize NCI40. Acquisition assets580=liabilities140+parent equity400+NCI40. Cash perimeter changes300 to190 through net acquisition outflow110.
Parent separate cash177/A542/L100/E442/profit62 and subsidiary cash59/A249/L55/E194/profit50 independently reconciled before consolidation.

Entire intragroup sale60 and balance15 eliminated; inventory margin10 removed. External-revenue180, external goods cost20 and other costs70 give group profit90. Dividend income12 is internal. Downstream margin belongs entirely to parent owners; NCI share12.5 and parent share77.5.

Group closing assets646/liabilities140/parent equity457.5/NCI48.5 reconcile, independently from combined assets791 minus investment150/internal balance15/unrealized10 plus goodwill30. Cash236 reconciles both company sums and outside cashflow190+70-24.

Upstream alternative adjusts subsidiary profit before NCI attribution. Full-NCI alternative changes measurement/goodwill without changing cash. Dividends leave group profit invariant but alter external cash and NCI; cash feasibility and legal distribution capacity remain separate.
